mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_NAME FROM COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
SELECT GROUPS_NO groupsNo, GROUPS_NAME groupsName FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUPS_NO IN (SELECT GROUPS_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER WHERE GRP_MEMBER_NO = #{ userNo })

SELECT u.USER_NO userNo, u.USER_NAME userName, u.PHONENUMBER phoneNumber, g.GROUPS_NAME groupsName, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName FROM users u LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION o ON u.user_no = o.user_no LEFT JOIN GROUPS g ON u.user_no = g.user_no
WHERE u.USER_NAME LIKE #{pattern} OR u.PHONENUMBER LIKE #{pattern}
OR u.USER_NO IN ( SELECT om.ORGMEMBER_NO FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER om JOIN ORGANIZATION org ON om.ORGANIZATION_NO = org.ORGANIZATION_NO WHERE org.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE #{pattern} )
OR u.USER_NO IN ( SELECT gm.GRP_MEMBER_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER gm JOIN GROUPS grp ON gm.GROUPS_NO = grp.GROUPS_NO WHERE grp.GROUPS_NAME LIKE #{pattern} )

SELECT U.USER_NAME userName, U.EMAIL email, U.PROFILEIMAGE profileImage, R.RANK_NAME rankName, P.POSITION_NAME positionName, O.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName, COMPANY_NAME companyName FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON U.COMPANY_NO = C.COMPANY_NO LEFT JOIN TITLE T ON U.USER_NO = T.USER_NO LEFT JOIN RANK R ON T.RANK_NO = R.RANK_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON T.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION O ON U.USER_NO = O.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_NO = #{ userNo }
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADDRBOOKMARK(TARGET_NO, USER_NO) VALUES(#{ targetNo }, #{ userNo })
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ADDRBOOKMARK WHERE TARGET_NO = #{ targetNo } AND USER_NO = #{ userNo }
